text:
noah kim: hey team, new hire here — unboxed a 14" MBP (M2) and followed the ABM + Kandji flow. Kandji says enrolled but macOS shows a captive portal error during cert install and FileVault errors with 'Escrow failed: timeout'. Okta says device not compliant. who do i ping? :wave:
it-desk: welcome noah! captive portals will usually break the SCEP/cert step. which network did you use (home/hotel/corp)? can you paste output of:
```
profiles status -type enrollment
sudo fdesetup status
```
(avoid full serials; last 4 is fine)
noah kim: set up on cafe wifi that had a login page. outputs:
profiles status -type enrollment: Enrolled to kandji: true; com.redwood.mdm present; com.redwood.security: not found
sudo fdesetup status: FileVault is Off
it-desk: that explains it. quick fixes: 1) connect to RWD-Corp or a phone hotspot (no captive portal) and visit https://kandji.redwood/setup-cert in Safari to force the CA; 2) open System Settings -> Privacy & Security and Allow any system extension banners; 3) run `profiles renew -type enrollment` and then `sudo fdesetup enable`.
sam peterson: if you can't get to corp wifi, we can push the missing profile from Kandji if you give us last 4 of the serial and grant a short temp admin window. also check Keychain Access -> Certificates for 'Redwood Corporate CA' after step 1.
noah kim: i'm remote for a few hours, can do hotspot. tried tether, got the cert prompt and accepted it. did profiles renew and now com.redwood.security shows up. ran `sudo fdesetup enable` and it failed with 'Escrow failed: TLS handshake failed'. Okta still non-compliant. last 4 serial: 2A7F
infra-bot: automated hint: TLS handshake failures often mean the hotspot is doing carrier-level proxying or UDP path MTU issues; switching DNS to 1.1.1.1 or using a different phone can help. Also wait ~5-10 minutes after cert install for MDM sync.
it-desk: we can also grant a 2-hour temporary admin to let you approve kernel/user prompts and, if needed, run our portal-based manual escrow (audited). want us to enable?
noah kim: please enable temp admin, i have a couple of apps blocked by the kernel prompts.
it-desk: done	— temp admin window opened for 2 hours. created ticket NH-20260505-19 and tagged endpoint + infra. you'll see a Kandji action to install the profile if needed. stay online for ~10 minutes.
noah kim: got the Kandji action, approved it, saw 'Redwood Corporate CA' in Keychain, allowed two system extension popups, and retried fdesetup — it shows 'Escrow in progress' then 'Escrow completed'. Okta shows compliant after sync. thanks all for the quick help! :tada:
